ck: (31)pavapratipa: nanvevan sati panurasitirturvarEva katasyapi katatvatikaranatvapavat katatvasya katepi nanate nityatvankikarat atyantapavapratiyokitvasyEva nityatvarupatvat tata ca yata kate katatvasyatyantapavastata tatatvan pratyanasrayatvaneva tasya praptaniti pratipantinasritya sankate — nanu tarhiti atyantapavatikaranasya pratiyokyanasrayatvankikara ityarta katatvatyantapavavati pate katatvan pratyanasrayatvavatkatatvatyantapavavati katepi tatanasrayatvan tvaya nankikartun sakyan tata sati katatvasya svatyantapavasananatikaranatvarupanityatvapavapatat tata ca katasya katatvasrayataya avasyankikaryatvena katanaprasitiriti pavena pratipantin pariharati neti katatvasya niratikaranatveneti patasya tu katatvan pratyasrayatvan nastyeva tatvatatepi katatvanankikare katatvaterniratikaranatvaneva prasacyata ityarta pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakanavacineti visesanakrtyan vaktunaksipati — nanviti tatapiti asitipariharepityarta pate vyapicara iti vyatireka trstantapute pate vyatirekavyaptervyapicara ityarta tanevopapatayati — pata iti satyapavasatpavepiti patapratiyokikatatvikatatatnyasatpavepityarta satanapavapavatiti satanasyEva satvatityarta tanevopapatayati — pata iti nanvatyantapavatikarane katan pratiyokinovakasa ityata uktan pate patasya nityatveneti svasananasrayatyantapavapratiyokitvasyEva nityatvataya nanatenkikaratityarta ata eveti uktavyapicarapariharartanevetyarta heturiti hetvantarkatotyantapava ityarta pratiyokisananatikaranyeti pratiyokina patatvena yatsananatikaranyan tatavacetakan yatpatiyapatatvatyantapavatvan tatavacinatayanavacinatapavastatkarpitasatanapavatityarta yatyapyatra pratiyokyasananatikaranetyeva patanistatyantapavo visestun sakyastavatEva patatvatyantapavavyavrtisite tatapi katatvatyantapavasyapi kate pratiyokisananatikaranatvatpratiyokyasananatikaranatvasyapavatatpratiyokitarnoprasita eveti punarasitisanka syatanirasaya pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakanavacinetyukti evanukte tu nasiti katatvatyantapavasya sarvatrEkatvepi prakrte patanistatyantapavapatena na sananyarupopavo vivaksita kintu patanistatvavavacinatyantapavavan etacatyantapavatvan na katatvasananatikaranyavacetakan tatavacetakan tu katanistatvavacinaneva nayinate ato na katantarpavena patanistatyantapavasya katatvarupapratiyokisananatikaranyanataya pratiyokyasananatikaranasyapavasyaprasiti sankya tatasca tatatitaheto katanasitiriti nanvitanekan santitsatanyacayavata ityapanan yato vyapicaravaranaya visesanopatane punarasiti prapta
